POLICE FORCE.
(COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.)

March 4, 19 31.

Deputy Commissioner (C.& S.)

Brigadier General H.B.H. Orpen-Palmer, Commandant
S.V.C., is leaving Shanghai on Sunday next at Noon
from the Customs Jetty and travelling to the Shanghai
and Hongkew Company's Pootung Wharf by launch. As he
will be in uniform and several other officers of the
Corps, also in uniform, will see him off on the Pootung
side, will you please arrange that the Chinese authorities
are notified in order that no untoward incident may occur
in Chinese territory.

（签名）
Commissioner of Police.

O.C. (SB)
Supt Tan to
notify the proper
authorities & report
result.
4/3 Lee

（总巡办公室。）

1931年3月4日。

副总监（华务与刑务）

万国商团司令奥彭-帕尔默准将 (Brigadier General H.B.H. Orpen-Palmer)
将于下周日中午离开上海，
从海关栈桥乘汽艇前往
上海虹口公司的浦东码头。鉴于他将身着制服，
且商团其他几名军官也将身着制服在浦东一侧送行，
请安排通知中国当局，以免在中国领土内
发生任何意外事件。

（签名）
警务总监。

O.C. (SB)
谭巡官去
通知有关
当局并报告
结果。
4/3 Lee
